nom: I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face Calming Korean Centella Asiatica Sleeping Mask

avis.texte: I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face Calming Korean Overnight Mask is a gel like cream that glides smoothly over the skin. I did notice a slight lavender scent that is calming. It is not a strong scent which is great for me since I don't like strong scented lavender scents. This one is good sleeping mask for night time and once I wake up and rinse it off with water. My skin feels soft and calm. The redness is reduced and the dryness isn't appearing around my mouth anymore. I received this product complimentary from I dew care.

Love this sleeping mask for soothing my irritated skin. It's lightweight yet hydrating, soothing but not oily and doesn't transfer to pillow during the night. It has a gel like texture and a slight lavender like fragrance, which is not overwhelming. You can actually see results after one use. Skin is smooth and looks healthier. *gifted by Idewcare
This is a great sleeping mask for calming redness, irritation and helping repair the skin barrier.

I've been trying the Resting Bliss Sleeping Mask at night, and it's honestly such a nice little treat. It feels cool and refreshing on my skin, and I love the light, calming scent. Perfect for unwinding after a long day at the beach- makes my skin feel soothed and ready for tomorrow. Gifted by idewcare

This facial sleeping mask is great when my skin is sensitized, it has a calming and soothing effect that makes my skin to feel refreshed and deeply hydrated. The great is that it keeps my skin moisturized along the night. Gifted by Idewcare.

I was excited to try the I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face Calming Korean Centella Asiatica Sleeping Mask because I enjoy trying new skincare products. It has a purple color and a light lavender scent. It has a thin lightweight texture that absorbs into the skin quickly. It contains some great ingredients that help to calm and soothe redness and irritation. Gifted by I Dew Care

Being such a cute Korean skincare brand, I'm always so excited to see whats new with them. I was gifted this Testing Bliss Face Calming Korean Overnight Mask complimentary from I Dew Care. It has little to no scent which is always preferable for me when it comes to skincare. It has a light airy texture that is a big greasy but nothing too bad, and it does eventually absorb in with a little.elbow grease! After wearing all night and rinsing in the morning, I could definitely see a huge difference. My complexion tends to reddened quite a bit, especially in the summer, whether it be heat, allergens, what have you. So I'm ALWAYS looking for calming skin care. I was so happy with this! After drying and sitting for a bit, my complexion was very even and my skin just over all felt soft and smooth! Love it and definitely recommend trying!

I received this product complimentary from I Dew Care in exchange for my honest opinion. First off the packaging is beautiful and glows in the dark. The smell is light and calming. The texture is thick and my skin loves it

I've been using the I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face Overnight Mask for a couple of weeks now, and it's quickly become a staple in my nighttime routine. The texture is this soft, gel like cream that feels instantly cooling and soothing when applied perfect for calming my skin after a long day. I love that it's not heavy or sticky like some overnight masks, so it doesn't feel like it's sitting on top of my skin. By the morning, my face feels soft, refreshed, and way less irritated. The light lavender scent is relaxing without being overpowering, which makes it a nice little self-care moment before bed. If you have sensitive or stressed skin and want something that works while you sleep, this is such a good pick. gifted by idewcare

Gifted by idewcare, I loved the glow in the dark detail of the packaging. It feels like a gel/ water on the skin. It has a gel scent to it and it is very shimmery (blue and purple). It peeled after drying on the chin and cheeks. After washing away the mask my skin feels soft and hydrated.

I absolutely love the New I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face Calming Korean Overnight Mask. When I wake up in the morning and rise off the mask my face feels amazing! I have aging skin so this is perfect for me to use frequently. I received this product complimentary from I Dew Care in exchange for my honest review.

I've been using the I Dew Care Resting Mask for a few weeks now, and it has quickly earned a spot in my nighttime routine. The texture is lightweight and soothing — it spreads easily and sinks into the skin without leaving a greasy feeling. I love the subtle, relaxing scent; it's calming right before bed. In the morning, my skin feels hydrated and refreshed, with a nice plumpness that makes makeup go on more smoothly. I also appreciate that it doesn't cause any irritation or breakouts, even on my sensitive skin. I was gifted by I dew care resting!

avis.titre: Calms skin and reduces redness overnight
avis.texte: The I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face Calming Korean Overnight Mask is an excellent part of any night time care routine. I use this mask about once or twice a week or whenever I feel like my skin needs a boost. This mask contains centella asiatica, lavender extract, and peptides. I notice a reduction in redness and calmer skin when I use this mask. I also appreciate that this mask is not too sticky and doesn't get all over my pillow. And how cool is on that the jar glows in the dark? This product was gifted by I Dew Care in exchange for my honest review.

This Korean overnight mask is a total game changer. Super lightweight but crazy hydrating. I wake up with soft glowy skin every time. No stickiness or breakouts, just smooth refreshed vibes. If your skin feels tired this one's a must try. Gifted by idewcare

I love this repairing overnight face mask. I have some damaged skin on my chin and after a using this mask my face looks less red and irritated. I love that it has cica to help repair my skin and it also smells really nice. Gifted by I Dew Care.

I love this calming overnight mask! As someone with sensitive skin, the Centella Asiatica really helps soothe my redness and irritation. After just one use, my skin felt noticeably softer and less irritated. I love the fact that it absorbs like a dream without any sticky residue, meaning I never have to worry about it transferring onto my pillowcase. It has became my new skincare staple. Gifted by idewcare

I was gifted by IDewCare so I wasn't sure what to expect but I love Korean skin care so I figured I would give this a try. The smell is nice but not overpowering. My skin had a beautiful glow the next morning after using it but didn't look greasy. I am excited to continue using it.

This product was gifted by iDewCare in exchange for an honest review. The packaging is playful and eye-catching—perfect for a sunny climate! The glow-in-the-dark jar charges easily in the sunlight, making it simple to find on my counter. The mask dried quickly, felt soothing on my skin, and didn't transfer to my pillow overnight. I woke up with a refreshed complexion and noticeably reduced redness. Such a fun and effective product!

I received this product free in exchange for a review. I dew care resting bliss calming mask works well over night. It has a slight floral scent but fades away. A little goes a long way, but I like to add extra since my skin needs the moisture. It absorbs well and doesn't leave any residue. I'm a fan of I dew care. I appreciate the ingredients and quality. This product was Complimentary from idewcare. Thank you!

This resting Bliss face calming Korean sleep mask by I dew care is amazing! At night, apply an even layer to your clean skin. Rinse it off in the morning with warm water while massaging In a circular motion and your skin will look amazing! I use it two times a week. I would highly recommend it! If you keep the container in the sun. It glows in the dark!This was gifted by idewcare.

I have been using this product and it is the best . My skin has been glowing and feels more hydrated . The packaging is perfect, glows in the dark . I am definitely going to be keeping this in my skincare routine . Complimentary from idewcare

Gifted by I Dew Care. So cute that the packaging glows in the dark. That definitely makes it more enticing to use and maybe even apply from bed. I love the feeling on my skin. It's very calming for my red skin and I do feel it on my skin in the morning.

This calming overnight mask is unreal. After a few uses, my skin felt so soft and looked noticeably younger. It was like I'd just had a facial. It hydrates, smooths, and gives you that fresh look. It feels like a spa treat every time I use it. I've never been this excited about a skincare product. Great results, absolutely recommend!!! Gifted by idewcare

I like the Resting Bliss Face mask because it calms my skin overnight and leaves it soft and refreshed by morning. The gel texture feels light yet hydrating, and the subtle lavender scent makes it a relaxing part of my routine. Gifted by idewcare.

This mask was gifted by I Dew Care. I like to use it on night when my skin feels a bit sensitive, it is a comforting addition to my skincare routine. The formula is light and absorbs nicely. My skin felt soft and smooth by morning.

This is a nice, thick, moisturizing night cream. It has a faint smell of fresh lavender but it's not overpowering at all. The cream is thick, and has small little beads in it that dissolve once you put on your moisturizer. It super hydrating, really took care of my dry skin at night. My face is fresh and hydrated in the morning. Gifted by Idewcare

I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face Calming Overnight Mask is great on my sensitive skin. The texture is light and creamy. The capsules breaks down easily. My face looks less irritated and is more hydrated. Gifted by idewcare

This mask is such a hidden gem. I wasn't expecting much, but wow, my skin feels noticeably calmer and more even every time I use it. It has that "I actually got sleep" effect the next morning, even when I didn't. I love how it melts into the skin without any heaviness, and the overall experience is just soothing. Gifted by Idewcare

I tried this NEW! I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face Calming Korean Overnight Mask gifted to me by idewcare and I love all their products. It makes me feel refreshed and calm after I use thier mask. Would recommend!

Complimentary from idewcare !!!! Everyone needs to try this brand and these mask so so good! I love how hydrating and smooth my skin feels and looks!!! Thanks I Dew Care for these products so much!!!!

Creamier than it's gel-like cousin the Hydrating mask by the same brand, I enjoyed this texture a bit more. While creamier, you still don't get any residue or heaviness with this cream. It also has a lighter scent than the hydrating mask, and I felt like it was more suited to my skin type. I really want to try the brightening mask! Gifted by I Dew Care.

Great moisturizer to use at night. It's a nice consistency. Absorbs quickly into the skin and doesn't leave a sticky feeling. I love the skincare ingredients this moisturizer contains. Must try! Gifted by idewcare

avis.titre: Not calming but nice for other reasons
avis.texte: Gifted by IDEWCARE | This resting bliss face calming overnight mask is a nice addition to my evening routine when I want a little extra pampering. It's a lightweight texture that smooths over the skin as the last step of my nighttime routine and in the morning my face feels super supple and soft. I don't know that it necessarily calms my skin as I have a lot of natural redness in my face but it definitely adds extra hydration which is great.

I really enjoyed using the I Dew Care Resting Bliss face mask. It felt nice and calming to go to sleep in - lightweight, not sticky, and best of all, it didn't mess with my pillow at all. When I woke up, my skin felt moisturized, soft, and noticeably more plump. A simple, no-fuss overnight mask that actually delivers on hydration. I received this product in exchange for my honest review, gifted by dewcare

I used this sleeping mask a few times and it feels super soothing on my skin. The texture is light and it sinks in well without being greasy. My skin feels calm and soft in the morning. It was gifted by idewcare and I was pleasantly surprised.

Complimentary from I Dew Care, this sleeping mask is a must-have for my nighttime routine. The texture is smooth and melts into the skin. I woke up with calm, hydrated skin after just one use. The centella and peptides really soothe my sensitive skin. Bonus—the jar glows in the dark. So fun!

Gifted by I Dew Care I've been loving the Resting Bliss Face Calming Sleeping Mask! It's super gentle on my sensitive skin and I noticed a difference even after the first use my face felt soothed, less irritated, and way more hydrated by morning. The ceramide capsules melt right in, and it never feels heavy or greasy overnight. What really stands out is the calming combo of Centella Asiatica, lavender extract, and the 13-peptide complex it feels like a spa treatment while you sleep. Plus, the glow in the dark jar is such a fun touch! Definitely a new favorite in my nighttime routine. 💜

I absolutely love this face mask! I use it right before I go to bed and the next morning my face looks super plump and moisturized! The texture is great going on my face, and feels super cool on my skin! I received this product for free gifted by idewcare.

I loveeee this stuff, it helps to soothe sensitive skin, calms skin, makes it feel nice & soft. Gifted by idewcare in exchange for my honest review. I def recommend to anyone who needs a calming agent for sensitive skin.

This mask feels super luxurious when you apply it and nice on my skin after a long summer day. I have sensitive skin so this is perfect for when I overdo it or just want a little extra pick me up without aggravating my skin. Gifted by idewcare

I received this product complimentary from I Dew Care. I have pretty good skin but sometimes get small bumps on my cheek near my jawline. This cream really helps calm my skin down if I wash my face twice a day instead of once. It feels soothing and keeps my skin from flaring up when I use my face wash more than usual. I love that it's gentle but works well for my skin needs.

Complimentary from I Dew Care. The jar glows in the dark which I think is such a unique feature of this product. I also like that this product has a lightweight formula that makes it absorb easily into the skin. I use this as the last step of my skin care routine before bed.

I received this complimentary from I dew care in exchange for my honest review. This has really cute packaging that glows in the dark. Definitely seems like it's geared for younger kids. This unfortunately did not work for my skin. I'm not usually sensitive but this made me break out.

I have a very sensitive and dry skin and usually need a rich moisturizer for night, but this product resolved my issue! It's so rich and lightweight at the same time and it contains centella asiatica which my skin loooves. This product was gifted by idewcare for my honest review!

Soothing, gentle, and perfect for sensitive or redness-prone skin. The texture is lightweight with a calming lavender scent, and it doesn't transfer to your pillow. Woke up with soft, calm, and refreshed skin. A great overnight reset—especially after a long day or active skincare. #gifted by idewcare

This sleeping masks feels so nice on my skin. Very easy to apply, the mask is very light and like a moisturizer. I apply after my night time shower and when I wake, wash it off. My skin feels soft after use. The product comes with a cute box that glows in the dark. Very fun look. No real scent to the product which is good for people who are sensitive to scent. Gifted by idewcare

Been winding down with the I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face overnight mask and it's become part of my night routine. The soft lavender scent is so soothing, and the formula feels rich but never heavy. I wake up with skin that looks calm, smooth, and well-rested 🌙 complimentary from idewcare.

So so hydrating!! I love a mask that I can leave on overnight and take off in the morning. I find those work better than ones I have to take off after 15 minutes. The packaging is also very cute. Complimentary from idewcare

avis.titre: Great buy for skin that needs calming
avis.texte: I don't usually care about the packaging, I focus more on the effectiveness of the product but I have to comment how unique and cute this container is glowing in the dark! I have dry, sensitive, some red skin and this made my skin visibly calmer/less red in the morning!! You get double the product amount than most skincare containers come!! It's cruelty free that means a lot to me. Complimentary from idewcare

I love everything from this company and you can add this now to one of my favorite products. This over night mask went in super light I almost didn't remember I put it on it. My skin felt softer and looked more glowy! Complimentary from idewcare

I love this I Dew Care Resting Bliss Face Calming Korean Overnight Mask! I put it on every evening and it makes my skin feel so soothed and renewed when I wake up. I like that it has lavender in it. Gifted by I Dew Care.

I absolutely love this! It is great that the jar glows in the dark- so cute- and it is even better that the sleeping mask is vegan and cruelty free. It is the perfect mask for calming my skin at night and making it look hydrated and balanced in the morning. Complimentary from idewcare.

I was gifted by idewcare for my honest opinion. I use it as a sleeping mask at night because it is lightweight and not sticky. It helps to soothe red patches on the skin. I like that it also glows on the dark.

Complimentary from idewcare. I think it is a good product for those with combination skin. It did help my acne not be so severe and made my skin feel great when I woke up. All in all I really enjoyed and plan to get more in the future.

Complimentary from idewcare. I enjoy it. It is not super drying and makes my skin feel good after waking up. I do think it helps with acne and made a noticeable difference. I would recommend for those with combination skin like I have. All in all I will be getting again

This is a nice mask that helps me to calm my skin when I got to much sunshine and feel ichy and hurt at the same time. I like the smell and how cool when I apply the mask to my face. I used it as a night time moisturizer for recovering my skin. Gifted by Idewcare

Love this mask so much! It makes my skin so much calmer and more even and hydrated! Great for my redness and helping out my sensitive skin! Gifted by I Dew Care in exchange for my honest review and feedback.
